title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The 'Protection et moyens de Subsistances (Protection and Livelihoods)' project in the territories of Beni (from 2026), Masisi and Lubero in the Democratic Republic of Congo, implemented by Oxfam through ICSP will directly reach 24,000 people working within 8 communities (from 2026) most affected by armed conflicts qualified in the 2022 OCHA humanitarian response plan. Oxfam will work with partners Solidarité pour la Promotion Sociale et la Paix (SOPROP) and Fédération des Producteurs Agricoles du Congo (FOPAC-North Kivu) to deliver strategy that aims to contribute to peace, stability, poverty reduction and the protection of civilians through interventions aimed at strengthening the capacities of communities to overcome the crises and challenges arising from them. The focus of Impact 3 is on building the capacity of local actors to undertake humanitarian responses and linking them to decision making spaces. Ultimately, ICSP intends to deliver on increased participation, representation and leadership of local actors in decision making platforms at district and regional levels and enhance humanitarian response and local leadership.
